description: This map displays an irregular geographic area, likely a country or region, overlaid with a regular grid of cells. Each peach-coloured grid cell contains a numerical value representing the total population for that cell. The map illustrates original source population data in a grid format, prior to border adjustments as part of a downscaling procedure. Numbers visible in the cells include: 1912, 748, 173, 1136, 734, 62, 1471, 722, 800, 799, 476, 300, 1502, 1345, 1465, 916, 2302, 3373, 341, 1242, 1739, 60, 2354, 2471, 205, 1011, 998, 1361, 389, 539. Along the irregular northern and western country boundaries, smaller values are present in partial grid cells, such as 141, 41, 12, 29, 140, 74, 173, 147, 10, and 0, indicating population counts for land portions within those cells. The highest population count observed is 3373.
